prompt: Thirty repositories should consume one centrally maintained, versioned CI workflow owned by the platform team. Which governance arrangement fits?
explanation: A reusable workflow gives the platform team one file, one version, and one place to fix things: callers pin it with `uses: owner/repo/path@ref`, and the organization’s allow list governs who may call what. Copies and wikis drift; references do not.

options.text: A reusable workflow in a central repository, allowed by organization policy and called with `uses:`
A composite action copied into each repository’s `.github/`
One giant workflow dispatched manually per repository
A wiki page describing the steps each team should reimplement
